verdict.rationale: Greenhouse is a SaaS ATS that ships AI features (Notetaker, Voice AI, Talent Matching, Offer Forecast), so a training opt-out is a fair question for it. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions a policy, setting, or contractual commitment that keeps customer or candidate data out of AI model training. The 'no data silos' note-taker claim concerns tool consolidation, not training use.
